description: Mobilité - Offre de transport du réseau bus- GTFS / GTFS-RT is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Poitiers Open Data. Grand Poitiers opens the data of regular lines of its public transit service (including lines operated by other providers). Here you can find the theoretical offer of the network (lines, stopping points, routes, timetables, unit tariff) in standard GTFS format. The data shall be updated periodically in the event of changes in the transport offer. Coverage: Grand Poitiers Open Data. The portal shows the English title as "Mobility - Transport offer of the bus network - GTFS / GTFS-RT" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Poitiers Open Data. Its keywords include horaires, bus, deplacement, gtfs, trajets, deplacements. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PBF, ZIP, URL. The listing shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
